title: Bicone two-sheet model: spinor holonomy gives factor 1/2
status: constructed model; NOT derived from archived K0 data

spinor_check.note: exp(i m delta) with m=+-1/2 gives exp(+-i delta/2): the factor 1/2 is the magnetic quantum number of the spin-1/2 representation -- i.e. the same 1/2 as j=1/2 of the defining SU(2) rep of 2I.

sheet_structure.sheets: two nappes of the double cone, disjoint except apex
sheet_structure.singular_point: apex (unique common point of the two sheets)
sheet_structure.Z2_exchange: nappe swap <-> S = 2 Z_S|_W on the RGS carrier

proved_in_model: two nappes are disjoint except at the apex
SU(2) weights m=+-1/2 reproduce the same half-angle
open: which cone angle alpha (if any) is selected by RGS/K0 data
whether the bicone apex maps to the K0 kernel or carrier
